name: Coccosteus
description: Compact arthrodire with sculpted cranial and thoracic plates, a coherent articulated oral passage, fine dermal pigment, a short flexible posterior, anterior pelvic fins and a sharply heterocercal tail.
notes: Original rework uses the accepted clay04 continuous surface and material04 dermal finish; complete source and prior models preserved.
Cranial, jaw and body LBS ownership reproduces the validated gape; a six-stage tail and segmented paired fins provide bespoke motion.
Pigmentation, soft-tissue thickness, fin compliance and behaviour are artistic reconstruction. Action names are compatibility gestures.
Full glTF embeds baked albedo, roughness and normal fields; texture-free LOD uses explicitly sampled linear pigment with verified export correspondence.

Accepted 13 September 2026: the bounded full/LOD surface review, the oral/eye temporal sweep over all eighteen clips and the playback and reduced-model switching check at game distance all passed, and the exports replaced the previous model. The swallow socket rides the jaw here, as the mouth socket already did.
